# HeartLink Consumer App

> Public-facing Expo Web client for the HeartLink platform. Marketing landing page hands off to app login; signed-in users browse verified inmate profiles and view detail with photo gallery + bio. Backed by the HeartLink Railway NestJS API. Live in production at https://heart-link-consumer.vercel.app.

## Project Overview

**Tech Stack:** Expo SDK 52 + Expo Router 4, React Native Web, Clerk auth, TypeScript
**Status:** Live in production (https://heart-link-consumer.vercel.app) — post-launch refinement (as of 2026-07-26)
**Purpose:** Public consumer surface for the HeartLink MVP — a marketing landing page that converts into the app login/browse experience. Web-first; native iOS/Android post-MVP.

## Key Files by Area

### Routes (Expo Router)
- `app/_layout.tsx` — Clerk provider + font loader + gesture handler root
- `app/index.tsx` — auth-aware redirect; public landing renders while Clerk/auth loads, signed-in users redirect when auth resolves
- `app/(auth)/_layout.tsx` — signed-out group, redirects to tabs if signed in
- `app/(auth)/sign-in.tsx` — Clerk sign-in
- `app/(auth)/sign-up.tsx` — Clerk sign-up + email-code verification
- `app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx` — signed-in tab navigator
- `app/(tabs)/index.tsx` — profile browse (responsive grid, filters, keyboard nav)
- `app/(tabs)/profile.tsx` — profile detail (hero + thumbnails + bio + details)
- `app/(tabs)/account.tsx` — sign out

### Lib
- `src/lib/api.ts` — inlined types + `createApiClient` (vendored from monorepo's `@heartlink/api-contract` + `@heartlink/api-client`)
- `src/lib/use-api-client.ts` — Clerk-token-aware factory hook
- `src/lib/use-public-profiles.ts` — `usePublicProfiles` (list) + `usePublicProfile` (detail) hooks
- `src/lib/use-keyboard-grid-nav.ts` — web-only arrow-key navigation between cards
- `src/lib/token-cache.ts` — Clerk token persistence (SecureStore native, localStorage web)

### Components
- `src/components/Landing.tsx` — production marketing landing page (approved/refined 2026-07-26); correspondence-first hero, immediate first paint while Clerk loads, trust bar for verified profiles/private correspondence/safety-first support, desktop + phone profile surfaces lead with "Write a letter"; hands off to app login
- `src/components/ProfileCard.tsx` — list card with hover + focused states
- `src/components/FilterSheet.tsx` — age / state / facility / plan tier filter modal
- `src/components/AuthShell.tsx` — auth screen scaffold (centered, branded, max-440px)
- `src/components/primitives.tsx` — Field, Button, Card, Pill

### Theme
- `src/theme.ts` — brand tokens (Deep Midnight Purple bg, Hot Heart Pink primary, Metallic Gold accent, Bree Serif + Inter)

### Build / Config
- `package.json` — deps + scripts (`dev`, `web`, `build:web`)
- `app.config.ts` — Expo config (single web bundler output)
- `babel.config.js` — babel-preset-expo + reanimated plugin
- `vercel.json` — build command + SPA rewrite
- `.env.example` — required env vars

## Common Tasks

**To run locally:** `npm install && npm run web` (with `.env` containing `EXPO_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY` + `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL`)

**To build for production:** `npm run build:web` → produces `dist/`

**To deploy:** `vercel --prod --yes` from repo root (this is what shipped the current production build). Vercel runs `npx expo export --platform web --output-dir dist`. Production URL: https://heart-link-consumer.vercel.app.

**To edit the marketing landing:** edit `src/components/Landing.tsx`. The approved hero uses in-surface stacked profile overlays inside both the desktop browser panel and the phone window; mobile keeps three controls including the second-look icon. Preserve this composition unless Zaire re-approves a change.

**To sync API types after admin contract change:** edit `src/lib/api.ts` by hand. Source of truth: `<monorepo>/packages/api-contract/src/index.ts` M3 W8 section.

**To add a new screen:** create `app/(tabs)/<name>.tsx`; if it should be tab-bar-visible add it to `(tabs)/_layout.tsx` Tabs.Screen list, otherwise add `options={{ href: null }}` and navigate via `router.push`.

## Environment Variables

- `EXPO_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY` — Clerk publishable key (shared with admin instance)
- `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL` — HeartLink Railway API base URL (set it explicitly for the target environment; current example uses `https://api-production-8a07.up.railway.app`)
- `EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPPORT_EMAIL` — public support inbox shown on the Support screen
